title: clippy -D warnings fails on lichen-link tests/shared_vectors.rs dead-code fields
description: tests/shared_vectors.rs CryptoMetadata fields (seed, private_key, public_key, preimage, signature) and LinkFrameVector.crypto are never read; cargo clippy -p lichen-link --all-targets -- -D warnings fails with dead_code. Pre-existing at HEAD (not introduced by worker6 fixes) and file has concurrent uncommitted WIP from another workstream (appended replay-window test). Fix by reading the fields in assertions or removing/allowing them once that WIP lands.
